title: TUR local model catalogue entry
description: One AI model TUR offers to run on the person's own computer (ADR-0021). Written in TOML, one file per model, in services/tur-ai-local/catalogue/<id>.toml; this schema describes the document the TOML parses to. The loader in services/tur-ai-local (src/catalogue.rs) is authoritative and also enforces rules this schema cannot express: the file is named <id>.toml; every file URL names the pinned revision and ends with the file's name; a projector is given exactly for models with the vision capability; pooling is given exactly for embeddings models, which have no other capability and do not think; tools and vision need chat; memory_bytes is at least the files plus kv_bytes_per_token times memory_context; memory_context is at most context_length; a licence with restrictions states them in sentences; ids and file names are unique across the catalogue.

id.description: Stable identifier: lower-case letters, digits, '.' and '-'. Never changes.

name.description: The name shown to a person.

publisher.description: Who makes and publishes the model.

repository.description: The publisher's own repository the files come from.

revision.description: The commit of that repository every URL is pinned to. Never a branch.

quantisation.description: The quantisation of the model file, as the publisher names it, for example Q8_0 or Q4_K_M.

parameters.description: The number of parameters as the publisher states it, for example 0.6B.

context_length.description: The longest context the model supports natively, in tokens.

memory_bytes.description: The memory needed at memory_context: the files, the 16-bit context cache and the engine's working memory. An estimate until measured.

memory_context.description: The context size memory_bytes is given for, in tokens.

kv_bytes_per_token.description: The size of the 16-bit context cache per token: layers x KV heads x head size x 2 (keys and values) x 2 bytes.

active_weight_bytes.description: The bytes of weights read for each generated token, where it is not the whole model file: a mixture-of-experts model reads only its active experts, and Gemma 4's per-layer embeddings are looked up, not multiplied. Without it, the model file's size. tur-ai-local estimates the speed of a model from it. At most the model file's size (the loader checks).

capabilities.description: chat: conversation. tools: OpenAI-style tool calling. vision: image input (needs the projector). embeddings: text embeddings only.

thinking.description: none: answers directly. hybrid: can think first or answer directly; tur-ai-local decides (--reasoning). always: thinks first.

pooling.description: For embeddings models: how token vectors become one vector (llama-server --pooling).

languages.description: BCP 47 tags as the publisher states them; mul means many languages.

languages_note.description: The publisher's claim about further languages, in its words.

good_for.description: What the model is good for, in plain sentences.

checked.description: When the entry was last checked against its sources.

projector.description: The image projector of a model with image input (llama-server --mmproj).

tested.description: What TUR measured with the model. Only from a real run with a report in this repository.

outcome.description: yes: it worked. no: it did not happen (for a tool call: the model answered in text). malformed: it happened but was not well formed. not-tested.

name.description: The publisher's file name, also the stored name.

url.description: The publisher's download URL, pinned to the revision.

size_bytes.description: The exact size; a file of another size is refused.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the whole file; a file with another digest is refused.

id.description: SPDX identifier, or LicenseRef- for a licence SPDX does not list.

url.description: The licence text, or the publisher's statement of it.

summary.description: What the licence lets a person do, in plain sentences.

restrictions.description: Exactly "none", or the use restrictions in plain sentences. Shown before download, never hidden.

evidence.description: What was read to establish the licence, and what could not be found.

report.description: The report in this repository, under docs/reports/.

peak_memory_bytes.description: The engine's peak resident memory. Left out when not measured.
